train_transform:
Compose(
    RandomResizedCrop(size=(224, 224), scale=(0.55, 1.0), ratio=(0.75, 1.3333), interpolation=bilinear, antialias=True)
    RandomHorizontalFlip(p=0.5)
    RandomApply(
    p=0.5
    RandomAffine(degrees=[-15.0, 15.0], translate=(0.12, 0.12), scale=(0.82, 1.0), interpolation=bilinear, fill=(124, 116, 104))
)
    RandomGrayscale(p=0.12)
    ToTensor()
    Normalize(mean=[0.485, 0.456, 0.406], std=[0.229, 0.224, 0.225])
    RandomErasing(p=0.25, scale=(0.02, 0.15), ratio=(0.3, 3.3), value=0, inplace=False)
)
eval_transform:
Compose(
    Resize(size=256, interpolation=bilinear, max_size=None, antialias=True)
    CenterCrop(size=(224, 224))
    ToTensor()
    Normalize(mean=[0.485, 0.456, 0.406], std=[0.229, 0.224, 0.225])
)
